Run the cell verify. Write the result to docs/history/semantic-token-diet/stdi-8-check.md (one line per truth, one line per moved rule, then the verify counts) and commit only that file. Report a defect; do not edit the checked files. Rules for every cell: keep every rule and its why-clause (agents-block-diet D6); keep test-pinned wording unless this action names the pin; never add a size limit (D1). Write no code comments.
